subject: Hospitality
title: Farm-to-Table: Buzzword or Reality?
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Farm-to-Table: Buzzword or Reality?.

hook.text: Farm-to-table promises locally sourced, seasonal food direct from nearby farms.

buildup.text: True farm-to-table means direct farmer relationships, seasonal menu changes, and accepting imperfect produce.

discovery.text: Dan Barber's Blue Hill at Stone Barns grows its own ingredients on-site. The farm dictates the menu—not the other way around.

twist.text: Many 'farm-to-table' restaurants quietly use the same distributors as everyone else.

climax.text: Authentic farm-to-table costs more and requires flexible menus. But diners increasingly demand transparency about food sourcing.

punchline.text: Some farms, some fiction. True farm-to-table lets the soil write the menu.

quiz.question: What did a Tampa Bay Times investigation reveal about farm-to-table?
options: Many 'farm-to-table' restaurants used the same distributors as everyone else—widespread fraud
